prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Oldwall: broken ancient walls among bracken and autumn woods above a quiet tarn. A patient, dignified theme suggesting a forgotten kingdom with cello and harp. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 2 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
